name: Awesome Black Friday & Cyber Monday Deals (twf-nikhila)
accepts: Software deals across categories, picked by what the product does ('a video editor goes in Video, whether it's an app, SaaS or AI'). iPhone, iPad and Mac apps are listed.
cost_note: Sponsor slots are sold; FormNX is a sponsor.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding one row at the end of the right category table in README.md, or, for people who are 'not technical', the form at https://fill.formnx.com/f/63pk80 (fields need JavaScript and were not read).
entry_format: | [Name](url) | One-line description of what it does | 💸 ♾️ **60% OFF** lifetime · code `BF26` | Nov 24, 2026 - Dec 1, 2026 |  (💸 for 50% or more, ♾️ for lifetime or buy-once; dates in exactly that style)
rules: Exactly four columns, one row at the end of the right category. Dates must use the format 'Nov 24, 2026 - Dec 1, 2026'.
Description is one line, no feature lists. Deal details start with the discount markers.
Check that the product is not already listed. Submit plain URLs; the maintainer adds UTM tags.
No licence box in the pull request template and no per-maker limit.
The maintainer may move a row to a different category when merging.
The merge comment asks for a star and a share. That is a request, not a condition.
status_note: 307 pull requests from outside authors merged since 1 Oct 2026, the latest on 20 Nov 2026; 19 open; 3 closed without a merge.
recommended_for: software of any kind, filed by what it does; iPhone, iPad and Mac apps listed
